expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.alpha===10 && S.m===2 && S.pinta==='puu' && S.komponentit===false && S.running===false && S.v===0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: alpha = 10°, m = 2,0 kg, wood on wood, no components, at rest (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='45' && R[0].step==='1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider: alpha 0-45° in steps of 1°

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===3 && L[0]==='2,3,4' && L[1]==='puu,muovi,kumi' && L[2]==='0.25,0.5,1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: mass, surfaces, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='alpha,m,pinta' && P.m.unit==='kg' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares alpha, m (kg) and pinta
